A short prime p>=11 has 8t<=3p, so TRACE-120 carries the kicked gap up to 10^39. At p=13 and p=31 the prime is on the CUE side of distance 1/2 and the square is above 3/4. No density is proved. The reflection contribution to the form factor is o(1). For a general hyperbolic S the reversing antiunitary of a position-diagonal kick is Theta' = D E_q K_0 from BGS-TRACE-131, equal to D K_0 when alpha is congruent to delta modulo p. An antiunitary that is not diagonal in the position basis is not classified. This is not the fixed kick, not the sixteen-phase ensemble, and not Haar measure on U(p). No Heisenberg-scale statement is proved. The m count is the diagonal count of Tanner and of Pakonski-Zyczkowski-Kus; the finite-p error constant is the extension proved here. BGS-TRACE-005 and BGS-BGS-001 remain open.

claims.title: Fixed diagonal kick: exact Pell-norm trace formula, orbit form and kernel structure; 2m law at m <= 8
claims.boundary: U = K_eta M_N with K_eta = diag e^{i eta f(q/N)}, f the fixed real 32-mode trigonometric position kick, S=[[3,4],[2,3]], odd N with gcd(N,D_m)=1, fixed m. claims.title: Automatic admissibility for NSW-prime m (Frobenius argument)
claims.boundary: For odd m with h_m prime and h_m > 18: (a) lambda^d != k'/k mod h for all d and k != k' in the support K of the kick symbol, and (b) lambda^a + lambda^b = 6 only for {a,b} = {1,-1}. Not used by BGS-TRACE-168, whose eleven instances are checked directly.

claims.title: Conjecture R: W~rest_m(eta) = o(m) uniformly on compact eta-ranges
claims.boundary: For 0 < eta0 <= eta1 < infinity, max_{eta in [eta0,eta1]} |W~rest_m(eta)| = o(m) as m -> infinity through odd m. (The NSW-prime version R_NSW, originally part of this entry, is BGS-TRACE-210.) Not reduced to a large-sieve inequality ('quadratic large sieve' phrasing withdrawn); Kurlberg-Rudnick, Bourgain and Bourgain-Glibichuk-Konyagin bounds do not apply since ord_h lambda = m is minimal. Derandomized analogue of the off-diagonal problem of BGS-TRACE-145 to 148; no progress on BGS-TRACE-148 is claimed. Line E annotation (2026-10-30, state unchanged): the k1-kick analogue of R is violated on a finite range (BGS-TRACE-187) and conditionally for all large m (BGS-TRACE-188); for this conjecture's kick |W~rest_m(2)| > m is certified at m = 11 and 13 only (BGS-TRACE-195, computer-assisted; an m = 17 certificate is pending and nothing is claimed for it) and asymptotic failure along 3 not dividing m holds only conditionally on H_infinity,7 (BGS-TRACE-196). R is not disproved. Line F/G annotation (2026-10-30, state unchanged): for the k1 kick the analogue of R now fails for every odd m >= 15 at eta = 2 unconditionally (computer-assisted, BGS-TRACE-199; also BGS-TRACE-201 at certified grid points), and for the pure 7-mode kick for 3 not dividing m (BGS-TRACE-200). For this conjecture's kick nothing changes: asymptotic failure is still only conditional on H_infinity,7 (BGS-TRACE-196). Conjecture R' (BGS-TRACE-206) is a separate, open conjecture about the k1 kick. R is not disproved. Line H annotation (2026-10-30): STATE CHANGED open -> refuted (Conjecture R as stated). For this conjecture's kick (Line B diagonal kick f_B, l = 0) at eta = 2, BGS-TRACE-209 (computer-assisted, on BGS-TRACE-207/208; independent referee audit, ACCEPT AFTER FIXES) gives W~rest_m(2)/m >= 1.4e4 for every odd m >= 47 with 3 not dividing m. Hence for every compact eta-range [eta0, eta1] containing 2, max_eta |W~rest_m(eta)| is not o(m), and R, which asserts o(m) for every compact range, is false. Scope of 'refuted': R exactly as stated here, for the Line B kick; it is not a statement about BGS (BGS-BGS-001 stays open; neither proved nor disproved) and not about BGS-TRACE-148. The NSW-prime version R_NSW, formerly part of this entry, is registered separately as BGS-TRACE-210 (open; split 2026-10-30). Not covered by BGS-TRACE-209: odd m with 3 not dividing m in {17,19,23,25,29,31,35,37,41,43} (m = 11, 13: BGS-TRACE-195), every m with 3 | m, eta != 2 (in particular the restriction of R to compact ranges avoiding 2 is open and not registered separately), and s = +1. The statements 'R is not disproved' in the Line E and Line F/G annotations above are superseded by this annotation. m = 17 annotation (2026-10-31; state unchanged): for this conjecture's kick at eta = 2, an m = 17 certificate gives W~rest_17/m >= 42.9787 (author implementation only, not independently reproduced; see the BGS-TRACE-195 annotation and evidence/executions/20261031/m17/). It is evidence and not part of the refutation, and m = 17 is not added to the certified range of BGS-TRACE-195.
